description: Cofounder dispatches a signal-first campaign (devtools-CTO ICP, volume 3). Outreach-agent claims the ticket, sources hiring-signal leads via exa + web_search, enriches via web_fetch, sends Touch 1 connection requests over the LinkedIn browser identity, appends the rows to the MEMORY.md pipeline ledger (file work — no tool event), files the routine digest ticket on the board, and completes with result + digest. No vault reads: the squad declares no secrets.

inputs.icp: CTO/VP Eng at seed-to-A devtools companies (5-50 ppl), hiring for platform roles

dispatch.title: Campaign: devtools CTOs, hiring signal, 3 leads

args.title: Campaign: devtools CTOs, hiring signal, 3 leads

args.query: LinkedIn profiles: CTO OR VP Engineering, devtools startup 5-50 employees, currently hiring platform engineers
site:linkedin.com/jobs platform engineer devtools seed stage 2026

args.purpose: verify the hiring signal + company size for lead 1

args.title: Outbound loop — 2026-06-12
args.context: 3 Touch-1 connection requests sent (hiring signal, devtools CTOs). 3 leads queued in pipeline, next due 2026-06-14. No replies yet — campaign day 1. A/B variants seeded for first DM.

args.comment: Campaign launched: 3 ICP-qualified leads sourced on the hiring signal, Touch 1 sent to all 3, pipeline ledger updated.

args.result: Campaign launched at volume 3 on the hiring signal. 3 ICP-qualified leads (CTO/VP Eng, seed-to-A devtools, all actively hiring platform roles) appended to Pipeline → Active leads in MEMORY.md, Touch 1 connection requests sent via LinkedIn browser identity, daily digest filed on the board as a routine ticket.
args.digest: Ran outreach.run_campaign: 3/3 leads sourced (hiring signal — Crunchbase/Jobs cross-check), Touch 1 sent, rows queued with Next due 2026-06-14. Signal quality good; no fuzzy ICP matches needed. Next wake: reply sweep + Touch 2 for any acceptances.
